caption: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Car is stationary post-impact; wall has a hole; front end is crumpled; no visible motion blur or debris trajectory. Unknown: Pre-impact velocity, deformation dynamics, energy dissipation over 3.333s.

INTERACTION: High pre-impact velocity → kinetic energy transfer → front-end crumpling + wall deformation → abrupt deceleration → stop.

PERSISTENCE: Crumpling and wall damage persist as static deformation; energy dissipation continues via heat/friction until thermal equilibrium; vehicle remains stopped.

INTERVENTION: If pre-impact velocity were lower → less crumpling, less wall damage, shorter stop time; if wall were indestructible → no hole, no crumpling, car bounces or rebounds; stop remains if deceleration force exceeds traction.
